_comment: mkmaze.c movebubbles() with mention_map on: arriving on the Plane of Water, newsym() redraws each square a bubble's monster leaves, and display.c show_glyph() prints a notice there, inside movebubbles(), before the bubbles' rn2(3) moves. The port queued it and drew the bubble moves before the notice's --More--. Fresh Valkyrie seed and date; the #wizlevelport menu keys are the established public setup.
